forecast-period.text: A high pressure system lies south of the Bight and will move into the Tasman Sea on Thursday. A low pressure system over Western Australian will move over South Australia on Friday, with an associated trough. A ridge of high pressure will follow and persist into the weekend.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Showers and thunderstorms about the west and north, showers possibly reaching the Eyre Peninsula in the evening. Thunderstorms may become severe in the far west. Maximum temperatures above average in the east, grading to below average about the west. Southeast to northeasterly winds, tending to fresh northwesterly in the north and west during the afternoon.
Dry apart from isolated showers or thunderstorms about the far northwest. South to southeasterly winds, fresh at times near the coast.

Scattered showers, tending isolated about the far northeast and western coasts. Thunderstorms possible across most districts, becoming more likely in the north and west. Maximum temperature below average in the west, grading to above average elsewhere. Southeast to northeasterly winds across the south and east, winds tending northwesterly ahead of a fresh west to southwesterly change extending throughout by evening.

Isolated showers about southern agricultural area and western coasts, possibly extending into the northern agricultural areas and southern pastorals. Isolated thunderstorms clearing from the north. Maximum temperatures above average in the northeast, below average elsewhere. South to southwesterly winds, freshening during the afternoon.

text.p: Isolated showers about southern agricultural area and western coasts. Showers and thunderstorms developing about the northwest. Maximum temperatures below average statewide. South to southeasterly winds, fresh at times about the coast.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: Generally, 1 to 5 mm increasing to 5 to 10 mm about the southern agricultural area. 10 to 20 mm west of about Ceduna, with isolated falls of 20 to 40 mm with thunderstorms in the west.
